title: Episode About the Creation the Khalsa Panth

blocks.text: The Guru and the initiated five mirror one another in a new exchange of authority, and the poet compares this mutuality to the succession from Guru Nanak to Guru Angad. (21–22)
With the amrit received, the Khalsa is said to arise as a formidable order, and from that day the Khalsa spread quickly through expanding circles of Singhs and local centers. (22; episode 16, 1–3)

Authority is distributed outward: wherever the Panj gather, khande-di-pahul may be given, ardas may be made, and the Khalsa acts with delegated responsibility rather than waiting on a distant center. (4–5)
